params.prompt: A single horizontal string of hanging papel picado banners: eight rectangular cut tissue-paper flags in magenta, turquoise, sunflower yellow, lime green, orange and lavender, each with intricate cut-out floral and geometric patterns, hanging from one thin white string with a slight natural drape.
